question: How can all activity and expression be understood as praise of Bhairava?
premises: Activity occurs through difference even in the undivided self.
Articulate expression arises in that differentiated activity.
inference: Because everything manifests and illumines him, all differentiated activity and speech can be taken as his praise.
plain_english: Even in the undivided self, activity appears through difference as articulate expression; and because all manifestation illumines him, everything becomes his praise.
